name: [STREETS UPD] CL: Streets [Under Development]
desc:
🔫 CL:Streets
MAP IS BEING REWORKED
A game that's currently under early development and is unfinished. This is currently a testing place for you to see the game being build in real time, EVERYTHING is subject to improvement and change. Your feedback is much appreciated, cars, mansions pawn shops, jobs and more are all coming soon.

💰 Earn cash from kills that will transfer over when the game is fully released
⚔️ Fight against everyone
📈 Stack your way to the top

Controls
🖥️ PC — WASD to move, M1 to shoot, M2/Q to aim
📱 Mobile — On-screen controls supported

⚠️ Zero tolerance for cheating. Exploiters and cheaters will be reported and banned. Keep it fair — or get gone.
